comment: Candidate pool for the week of 2026-08-31 (late summer tipping into early fall). Discovery is the public weekday-dinner-recipes skill's job: it searched the curated sources, pulled the star rating and review count off each live page and confirmed no 404s. This file is that batch, annotated with the dish/source/cuisine/role/protein the planner needs and ranked by editorial preference. Constraint flags (tomato, sesame, timing) are NOT recorded here on purpose -- they are derived from the recipe's own ingredients and totalTime after import, so a hand-typed flag can never be wrong.

pool.title: Cold Sesame Noodles
pool.why: No-oven 20-minute night while it is still 90 degrees out. Peanut-sesame dressing over spaghetti with bell pepper, cucumber and herbs.

pool.title: Parmesan-Herb Baked Salmon
pool.why: Seafood night that is genuinely 25 minutes. Four ingredients on the fish, one pan.

pool.title: Shakshuka
pool.why: The week's one tomato-heavy meal, and a skillet-and-bread dinner that needs no side.

pool.title: Sheet Pan Balsamic-Herb Chicken and Vegetables
pool.why: Chicken night with the vegetables already on the pan. Nothing else to cook alongside it.

pool.title: Oven Roasted Autumn Medley
pool.why: The first properly fall dinner of the year: sausage, sweet potato, apple, sage. Friday, when an hour in the oven is fine.

pool.title: Chicken Shawarma Sheet Pan Dinner
pool.why: Alternate chicken night; marinade is hands-off but it lands in the 45-60 band.

pool.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
pool.why: Alternate vegetarian night. Long for a weeknight, and the avocado-pepita dip is a second component.

pool.title: Baked Cod Recipe with Lemon and Garlic
pool.why: Alternate seafood night, 22 minutes, needs a starch alongside it.

pool.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Sausage Dinner
pool.why: Alternate one-pan night; sits right on the 45-minute line.

pool.title: Sesame Noodles with Wilted Greens
pool.why: Alternate sesame night with a jammy egg on top.

pool.title: Veggie Black Bean Enchiladas
pool.why: Alternate vegetarian night; a full hour, so only worth it on a Friday.
